notes: Built from the approved build sheet docs/ship_pipeline/build_sheets/deathless_E12/ (design file tools/blender/build_sheets/ships/deathless_E12.py). The sheet is the one home of the design (RULEBOOK 0.9, R225): masses, parts, mounts, seams, insides, hard points and the ship length (LENGTH 14.5, the Cruiser class length) come from it through tools/blender/build_sheets/contract.py; this file only names the sheet, the game ids, the concept and the recipe settings. No parts list here: the sheet places every part. game_code D21_23 is the Cruiser folder the game picks for deathless (godot/render/hull_table.gd AI_HULLS); an install replaces the old hull there, copied aside first. bake none until the Eclipse paint stack lands (a separate job after issue 618). Stage 3 does not trace or tune a sheet hull; it fits the concept camera and reports the outline.
